text.description_html:
NGP-SC, Soft Close Device for Pocket Door Track

This is a National Guard soft close device for aluminum pocket door top mount track system. Designed for doors 120 lbs. - 150 lbs.

Features for National Guard SLAL-250-PD Pocket Door Track System

  • Minimum Door Width on a Single Door is 16"
  • Designed for Doors 120 lbs. – 150 lbs.
  • Slows Travel of the Door to Softly Close
  • Soft Close for Single Sliding Aluminum Hardware Sets

Special Ordered Item. No Returns.
